name: Chauchina (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Chauchina (a church between trees on white and a river on green).
history: Municipal flag of Chauchina; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Chauchina arms — church between trees and river
